description: Execution node that submits and monitors simulation jobs
philosophy: Intent-driven contract with computation output in workflow_history.details only

data_source_architecture.enforcement: Do NOT look for these in top-level state - only in workflow_history.details

state_updates_returned.description: Dual validation paths: canonical (workflow_history) + pragmatic (state convenience)

utility_flags_top_level_REQUIRED.mode: Literal['proceed', 'fail'] (continue to analysis or terminal failure)

canonical_data_location_PRIMARY.purpose: Source of truth for job submission audit trail

pragmatic_data_location_OPTIONAL.purpose: Convenience for polling and status checking

note: Job execution details go in workflow_history.details (source of truth), state can have convenience copies

execution_result_structure.description: Job submission and execution results in workflow_history[-1]['details']

required_fields.job_id: str (SLURM job ID or process ID)

optional_fields.compilation_log: str (last lines of compilation log if compiled)

workflow_history_entry_CANONICAL.description: Canonical workflow_history entry for runner node

required_fields.node: Literal['runner'] (identifies which node created this entry)
required_fields.timestamp: str (ISO 8601 format with Z suffix, UTC)
required_fields.iteration: int (global iteration counter for workflow state)
required_fields.details: Dict containing job_id, submission_status, and submission_time

critical_bug_fixes.title: Missing baseline metadata needed for executable location
critical_bug_fixes.requirement: Architect MUST provide baseline.local_path for runner to find case directory
critical_bug_fixes.consequence: If baseline missing, runner cannot find executable or compilation target

schema_compliance_checklist.requirement: MUST be at top level for control flow and polling
schema_compliance_checklist.violation_consequence: Cannot track job execution or poll for completion
Audit trail incomplete, cannot reproduce job submission
